options.systemMessage:
=={{ 
[
  $('Salon Config').first().json.salon_knowledge_prompt,
  'Known client name: ' + ($('Get or Create Client').first().json.known_name || 'unknown'),
  'If the user name is already known from the client database, do not ask for it again unless the user explicitly gives a different name.',
  '',
  'You are an AI receptionist for a beauty salon.',
  '',
  'Your task:',
  '- Understand the user intent: booking, cancellation, reschedule, availability question, or FAQ.',
  '- Convert natural human wording into a strict machine-readable format for the workflow.',
  '- Output ONLY one of the exact formats below, or a short natural follow-up/FAQ answer when details are missing. Do not output JSON.',
  '',
  'For booking, output exactly:',
  'BOOKING REQUEST READY',
  'Name: [normalized name]',
  'Service: [normalized service]',
  'Date: [normalized date]',
  'Time: [normalized time]',
  '',
  'For cancellation, output exactly:',
  'CANCEL DETAILS',
  'Name: [normalized name]',
  'Date: [normalized date]',
  'Time: [normalized time]',
  '',
  'For reschedule, output exactly:',
  'RESCHEDULE DETAILS',
  'Name: [normalized name]',
  'Current Date: [normalized current date]',
  'Current Time: [normalized current time]',
  'New Date: [normalized new date]',
  'New Time: [normalized new time]',
  '',
  'If the user only expresses cancel intent but details are missing, output exactly:',
  'CANCEL REQUEST',
  '',
  'If the user only expresses reschedule intent but details are missing, output exactly:',
  'RESCHEDULE REQUEST',
  '',
  'Never add explanations around structured outputs.'
].join('\n')
}}

parameters.text:
={{
'✅ NEW BOOKING REQUEST\n\n' +

'Client Telegram name: ' +
($('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message?.from?.first_name || $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message?.from?.username || 'Unknown') +

'\nTelegram ID: ' +
($('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message?.chat?.id || $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message?.from?.id || '') +

'\n\nName: ' +
$('Parse Booking Details').first().json.name +

'\nService: ' +
$('Parse Booking Details').first().json.service +

'\nDate: ' +
$('Parse Booking Details').first().json.pretty_date +

'\nTime: ' +
$('Parse Booking Details').first().json.time.substring(0,5) +

'\nDuration: ' +
$('Parse Booking Details').first().json.duration_minutes +

' min' +

'\n\nClient message:\n' +
($('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message?.text || '') +

'\n\nCalendar event created: YES'
}}

parameters.jsCode:
const chatId = $('Normalize Telegram Input').first().json.chat_id || $('Telegram Trigger').first().json.message?.chat?.id || '';
return [{ json: { channel: 'telegram', recipient_id: chatId, message_text: 'You cannot book in the past. Please choose a future date.' } }];
